aboutDescription: MAYO Share wani aikace-aikacen canja wurin fayiloli ne na kyauta, buɗaɗɗen tushe, mara intanet don Windows. Yana ba ka damar aika da karɓar fayiloli ba tare da intanet ba, ta amfani da Wi-Fi na gida ko wurin zafi. An tsara shi don makarantu, ofisoshi, da wurare masu nisa inda bayanai ke da tsada ko babu su.

step1Instruction: Danna maɓallin da ke ƙasa don buɗe Mayen Kayan Aiki. Lokacin da taga ta buɗe, danna menu na "Action" ka zaɓi "Add legacy hardware". Sannan danna "Next".
step1Note: Mayen zai jagorance ka yanzu wajen shigar da adaftan madauki da ake buƙata.
step2Instruction: A cikin mayen, zaɓi "Install the hardware that I manually select from a list" ka danna Next. Sannan zaɓi "Network adapters" ka danna Next kuma.
step2Note: Allon na gaba zai ba ka damar zaɓar adaftan hanyar sadarwa ta musamman.
step3Instruction: A cikin jerin Manufacturer, zaɓi "Microsoft". A cikin jerin Model, zaɓi "Microsoft KM-TEST Loopback Adapter". Danna Next, sannan Finish don shigarwa.
step3Note: Za a shigar da adaftan ta atomatik da zarar ka danna Finish.
step4Instruction: Danna maɓallin da ke ƙasa don duba ko an shigar da adaftan daidai.
step4Note: Ya kamata ka ga alamar kore idan komai ya shiryu.
